prompt: The image is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the chaotic intimacy of a theatre backstage. On the far left, a woman in a sequined gown stands tall, her posture rigid with anticipation. Next to her, a man in a tuxedo adjusts his bowtie, his fingers fumbling slightly with the silk. A brown leather suitcase sits on the floor near their feet, its latches undone. In the center foreground, a young boy in oversized overalls crouches low, holding a tangled coil of black rope. He looks intently at a grey cat perched on a wooden crate, which stares back with wide, unblinking eyes. Behind them, a stagehand in blue coveralls points toward a stack of painted flats leaning against the wall. The flats depict a forest scene, their edges rough and unfinished. To the right of the stagehand, an older actress in a velvet robe sits on a folding chair, her head tilted back in exhaustion. A makeup artist in a white smock leans over her, applying powder with a soft brush. Near the right edge, a drummer in a striped shirt taps rhythmically on a snare drum resting on a stool. A brass trumpet lies discarded on the floor next to the drum, gleaming faintly in the dim light. Above them, a spotlight hangs from the ceiling rigging, its cord dangling loosely. A script with red markings rests on a nearby table, pages fluttering in a draft. A coffee cup with steam rising sits beside the script, half-empty. There is no digital screen visible in the background. There is no modern smartphone in anyone's hand. The woman in the sequined gown glances at the man in the tuxedo. The man in the tuxedo hands a ticket to the woman in the sequined gown. The young boy in oversized overalls reaches for the grey cat. The grey cat swats at the young boy in oversized overalls.
